name: io.github.abe238/hotin
description: What's hot in AI right now, ranked with receipts from GitHub, HN, npm and Hugging Face.

packageArguments.description: Starts the MCP server. Without it the CLI prints usage and exits, so this is not optional.

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Only the 'insiders' tab needs it, to poll what notable developers starred. Every other tab works with no key at all.
